name: cua
description: Scale computer-use 2.0 with open-source drivers, cross-OS fleets, and benchmarks for training, evaluation, and data generation.
one_liner: Gives an AI agent its own remote computer it can click around and operate, like a robot temp worker using any desktop app through a screen and mouse.
buyer: An operations manager at a small company drowning in repetitive desktop tasks (data entry into an old desktop app, filling out portal forms) who can't get IT to build a proper API integration.
business_use_cases: A back-office outsourcing firm automates form-filling in a legacy desktop application that has no API, using an agent that operates it like a human would.
A QA team spins up isolated cloud desktops to run automated UI regression tests across real operating systems.
An agency builds and sells narrow 'RPA bots' for clients stuck with old Windows-only software, billed per automated workflow.

money_ideas.idea: Build a niche RPA agency automating one specific painful legacy-software workflow (e.g. insurance portal data entry) and sell it to that industry.
Resell managed cloud-desktop capacity plus a pre-built automation as a turnkey package for a specific task.

steal_this: Pick one tedious desktop-only workflow at a local business (e.g. entering orders into an old POS system) and build a paid automation for it this weekend.
